description_en: Queries the information about table indexes
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-adb-mysql-indexes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-uf6wjk5xxxxxxxxxx --schema tpch_oss --table-name orders --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAdbMySqlIndexes

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html 接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the table.

If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all the current tables in the cluster is returned
parameters.help_zh:
目标表名。
若该参数留空，则会返回当前日期内目标集群下所有表的使用频次数据
parameters.name: table_name
